building: St. Thomas Aquinas Catholic Center at Purdue

categories.name: Identity and plan evidence
categories.evidence: Correct GIS FID 852 and named OSM way 117396617; projected GIS/OSM IoU is 0.922. Structural shell follows the GIS ring by construction, not an independent wall survey.

categories.name: Massing and architectural silhouette
categories.evidence: The gabled sanctuary, bell tower/cross, and three connected component zones read; addition forms and roof transitions remain approximate.

categories.name: Facade and architectural detail
categories.evidence: Entry sign, masonry, trim, windows, and canopy are present, but repeated bays and simplified junctions lack the reference photographs' detail.

categories.name: Materials and surface finish
categories.evidence: Portable material groups are assigned; repeated stripe artifacts and flat-looking brick, glass, and roof response reduce fidelity.

categories.name: Interior and program
categories.evidence: Sanctuary furnishings are recognizable; classroom furnishings are sparse and the structural/circulation logic is not established.

categories.name: Technical integrity and integration readiness
categories.evidence: The exact asset reopens cleanly, but the manifest still indexes it as campus-coordinate massing while its geometry is local and its origin exists only as a custom property.

categories.name: Evidence and uncertainty
categories.evidence: GIS/OSM raw data, official architect/parish references, conversion, retrieval date, and uncertainty are documented.

limitations: Master placement was not opened or verified; manifest coordinate mode is inconsistent with the local geometry.
Campus GIS is a map outline, not a surveyed wall footprint.
Roof heights, pitches, component boundaries, interior partitions, and furniture are unverified or estimated.
Inspection renders are not photorealistic final-render outputs.
